data.narrative:
Swan is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $38.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies, supplemented by reference to a broader universe of 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private) including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis across the four identified comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B Seed), Singularity ($400M Series A), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and capital intensity within the defense tech sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $398M. Key uncertainties include the relevance of the peer set given the nascent stage of the sector, the capital intensity and path to profitability in defense applications, and the degree to which late-stage peers (Series A valuations) appropriately anchor early-stage pricing. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects fundamental uncertainty about where Swan sits relative to its peer cohort.
